'''Cannison''' was a [[Minister]] who was married to [[Mrs. Cannison|Mrs Cannison]] and joined [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sargo VenHalgon]] on a vacation to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They landed on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and Cannison, VenHalgon and [[Worrita (Professor)|Worrita]] went off hunting. However, they were chased up a cliff by a [[Kilassin]]. They were eventually rescued by the crew of the ''[[Starchaser IV]]''.
